RagShortTexts: Riga commanded the Daugava estuary as the ecclesiastical and crusading spearhead of Livonia.

Variants.Content: Founded near the mouth of the Daugava, Riga functioned as the crusading and commercial hub of Livonia. Shared between the Prince-Archbishop of Riga and the Livonian Order, its fortified harbor funneled Russian furs and wax to western Hanseatic ports.
Stone battlements sheltered German burghers from indigenous revolts, anchoring Christian feudal colonisation along the eastern Baltic.
